title: Fermat's Equation over Number Fields
description: Explores x^n + y^n = z^n over number fields. Wiles (ℚ), Freitas-Hung-Siksek (real quadratic), and the modularity obstruction.

meta.author: Wiles, Freitas-Hung-Siksek
meta.assumptions: 1 axiom (flt_over_Q). 0 sorries. WARNING: asymptotic_flt proves True (placeholder). freitas_hung_siksek and modularity_obstruction mentioned in comments but not axiomatized.

conclusion.summary: FLT over number fields remains largely open. The modularity obstruction is the key difficulty.
